# Termux-STT Full Technical Specification (v1.1.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure Python 128d X-Vector Speaker Diarization
Integrates Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with a closed-form pure-Python 128-dimensional X-Vector clustering algorithm that operates in under 80MB RAM with zero cloud egress.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-stt
- Command: pip install --upgrade termux-stt && termux-stt install
# or Node.js:
npm install -g termux-stt && termux-stt install
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt
